meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 给你的 Claude 装上持久记忆:回答前自动调出相关旧上下文,每轮结束后把新结论存下来。记忆写在 agent 分组的 .claude/ 挂载里,容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 仅对使用默认 Claude provider 的 agent 分组生效(container.json 里 provider 缺失或为 claude);换成 opencode 等其他 provider 时 hooks 不会运行。

say.text: 帮我安装 mnemon,并确认各分组用的是默认 Claude provider
重建容器镜像、重启服务,然后验证 mnemon 的 hooks 已注册
say.note: 会构建镜像、重启服务并看 settings.json

say.text: 上一次会话我提到过的事情,你还记得吗?
say.note: mnemon 应自动调出那段上下文

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon into the agent container image so Claude recalls relevant past context before answering and stores new insights after each turn. Memory lives in the group's .claude/ mount and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Applies to agent groups on the default Claude provider (provider absent or "claude" in container.json). Groups with another provider, such as opencode, never run the hooks.

say_en.text: Install mnemon and confirm the groups use the default Claude provider
say_en.note: Checks the provider in container.json first.

say_en.text: Rebuild the container image, restart the service, then verify the hooks
say_en.note: Builds the image and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Do you still remember what I mentioned in that earlier session?
say_en.note: mnemon should surface that context automatically.
